name: GLightbox Media Video
description: Adds GLightbox support to Media Video and Remote Video types.
project_description:
GLightbox Media Video extends GLightbox module with support for Drupal core Media Remote Video and local Video.

 Features 
 The GLightbox Media Video module: 

 
 Works as a Formatter for Video URL field in Remote Media Video 
 Choose between a text or thumbnail to launch a GLightbox 
 Supports Media thumbnail and image styles 
 Supports Gallery (video grouping) - aka GLightbox rel 
 
 Installation 
 1. Install the module as normal, see link for instructions.

Link: https://www.drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-8 

 2. Go to "Media types" -> "Remote Video" -> "Manage display" -> "Video URL"

=> select GLightbox Remote Media Video formatter and adjust settings
